highlights:
Open-heel mule construction: A closed toe is combined with a fully open back, allowing the foot to slide into the knitted upper.

Patterned knit upper: Larger visible knit openings across the forefoot contrast with denser sections around the side and entry edge.

Sculpted EVA outsole: Angled grooves and a raised sidewall give the sole its distinctive profile, visible in the actual side and bottom photographs.

Five colour directions: White/Green, Red/Black, Purple/Black, Coffee and All Black pair the knitted upper with matching or contrasting sole colours.

Wholesale assortments: This backless closed-toe style is listed in EU35-46 for colour-size mixes.
